Amazon Paging is an incident response system aimed to reliably deliver critical engagement content to targeted responders in Amazon and Amazon subsidiaries. It is utilized within Amazon and other AWS services to quickly and effectively resolve critical incidents by delivering messages to the right person in right channel at the right time.

Amazon Paging mobile application allows you to:
        * Receive push notification alerts
        * Set custom alarm sounds for alerts or set up do not disturb settings
        * Quickly access and respond to incident notifications (acknowledge and/or check-in to corresponding tickets)
        * Confirm paging readiness/device health with connection status information at a glance and push notification tests
        * View and manage your paging history

NOTE: You must be onboarded with an Amazon paging contact before being able to leverage the Amazon Paging mobile application.
